## 1) Pakete laden

```{r}
#| label: packages

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(patchwork)
library(ggnewscale)


```

## 2) Xylos-Datenbank einlesen & filtern

```{r}
#| label: load-xylos

base_path <- "C:/Users/user/Documents/Master_EnvironmentalSciences/Master_Thesis"
xylos <- read.csv(file.path(base_path, "/Beetle_traits/Xylos_R.csv"), sep = ";")

my_species <- c(
  "Pterostichus_aethiops", "Anthaxia_quadripunctata", "Anthaxia_fulgurans",
  "Chrysobothris_affinis", "Buprestis_haemorrhoidalis", "Bolitophagus_reticulatus",
  "Rhagium_bifasciatum", "Rhagium_inquisitor", "Rhagium_mordax",
  "Rutpela_maculata", "Stenurella_melanura", "Pachytodes_cerambyciformis",
  "Corymbia_rubra", "Grammoptera_ruficornis", "Ips_typographus"
)

# final -> Datenbank-Schreibweise
synonym_map <- c(
  "Rutpela_maculata" = "Leptura_maculata",
  "Corymbia_rubra"   = "Stictoleptura_rubra",
  "Uleiota_planatus" = "Uleiota_planata"
)

xylos$species_final <- xylos$species
for (final_name in names(synonym_map)) {
  xylos$species_final[xylos$species == synonym_map[final_name]] <- final_name
}

xylos_filtered <- xylos[xylos$species_final %in% my_species, ]
xylos_filtered$species <- xylos_filtered$species_final

cat("Arten gefunden:", nrow(xylos_filtered), "von", length(my_species), "\n")

xylos_sel <- xylos_filtered[, c("species", "gilde", "nahrung", "wald",
                                 "niche_decay", "frischholz")]

setdiff(my_species, xylos_filtered$species)
```

## 3) Hagge-Datenbank einlesen & mergen

```{r}
#| label: load-hagge

hagge <- read.csv(file.path(base_path,
  "Beetle_traits/Hagge DB/Hagge_etal_saproxylic_beetle_morphological_trait_database_20210426.csv"))

# Gleicher Synonym-Lookup wie in Kapitel 2 (final -> Datenbank-Schreibweise)
# Falls Hagge andere Synonyme als Xylos nutzt, hier anpassen -- Check unten
hagge$species_final <- hagge$species
for (final_name in names(synonym_map)) {
  hagge$species_final[hagge$species == synonym_map[final_name]] <- final_name
}

hagge_filtered <- hagge[hagge$species_final %in% my_species, ]
hagge_filtered$species <- hagge_filtered$species_final

cat("Arten in Hagge:", nrow(hagge_filtered), "\n")
cat("Fehlend:", my_species[!my_species %in% hagge_filtered$species], "\n")

hagge_sel <- hagge_filtered[, c("species", "body_length",
                                 "hairiness_total", "colour_lightness",
                                 "wing_load", "mass")]

beetles <- merge(xylos_sel, hagge_sel, by = "species", all.x = TRUE)

# Pterostichus manuell hinzufügen (nicht in Hagge-DB)
# Ökologische Daten nach Büche (carabidfauna.de)
pterostichus <- data.frame(
  species          = "Pterostichus_aethiops",
  gilde            = "a",
  nahrung          = "z",
  wald             = "b",
  niche_decay      = NA,
  frischholz       = NA,
  body_length      = NA,
  hairiness_total  = NA,
  colour_lightness = NA,
  wing_load        = NA,
  mass             = NA
)

beetles <- bind_rows(beetles, pterostichus)
cat("Gesamt:", nrow(beetles), "Arten\n")
```

---

## 4) Taxonomie & Variablen aufbereiten

```{r}
#| label: prepare

beetles$species_clean <- gsub("_", " ", beetles$species)
beetles$niche_decay_num <- as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", beetles$niche_decay))

beetles <- beetles %>%
  mutate(
    family = case_when(
      species == "Pterostichus_aethiops"                ~ "Carabidae",
      species %in% c("Anthaxia_fulgurans",
                     "Anthaxia_quadripunctata",
                     "Chrysobothris_affinis",
                     "Buprestis_haemorrhoidalis")        ~ "Buprestidae",
      species == "Bolitophagus_reticulatus"              ~ "Tenebrionidae",
      species %in% c("Rhagium_bifasciatum",
                     "Rhagium_inquisitor",
                     "Rhagium_mordax",
                     "Rutpela_maculata",
                     "Stenurella_melanura",
                     "Pachytodes_cerambyciformis",
                     "Grammoptera_ruficornis",
                     "Corymbia_rubra")                   ~ "Cerambycidae",
      species == "Ips_typographus"                      ~ "Curculionidae",
      species == "Uleiota_planatus"                     ~ "Silvanidae"
    ),
    superfamily = case_when(
      species == "Pterostichus_aethiops"                ~ "Caraboidea",
      species %in% c("Anthaxia_fulgurans",
                     "Anthaxia_quadripunctata",
                     "Chrysobothris_affinis",
                     "Buprestis_haemorrhoidalis")        ~ "Buprestoidea",
      species == "Bolitophagus_reticulatus"              ~ "Tenebrionoidea",
      species %in% c("Rhagium_bifasciatum",
                     "Rhagium_inquisitor",
                     "Rhagium_mordax",
                     "Rutpela_maculata",
                     "Stenurella_melanura",
                     "Pachytodes_cerambyciformis",
                     "Grammoptera_ruficornis",
                     "Corymbia_rubra")                   ~ "Chrysomeloidea",
      species == "Ips_typographus"                      ~ "Curculionoidea",
      species == "Uleiota_planatus"                     ~ "Cucujoidea"
    )
  )

# Gilde als Faktor
beetles$gilde <- factor(beetles$gilde,
  levels = c("f", "a", "p", "m", "s"),
  labels = c("fresh wood", "old wood", "wood-decay", "mould cavity", "special"))

# Nahrung als Faktor (inkl. zoophagous für Pterostichus)
beetles$nahrung <- factor(beetles$nahrung,
  levels = c("x", "m", "xm", "d", "z"),
  labels = c("xylophagous", "mycetophagous", "xylo-mycetophagous",
             "mixed", "zoophagous"))

# Wald als Faktor
beetles$wald <- factor(beetles$wald,
  levels = c("l", "n", "b"),
  labels = c("deciduous", "coniferous", "both"))

species_order <- c(
  # Buprestidae – Frischholzbesiedler, xylophag
  "Anthaxia fulgurans",
  "Anthaxia quadripunctata",
  "Chrysobothris affinis",
  "Buprestis haemorrhoidalis",
  # Cerambycidae – gemischt
  "Rhagium bifasciatum",
  "Rhagium inquisitor",
  "Rhagium mordax",
  "Grammoptera ruficornis",
  "Pachytodes cerambyciformis",
  "Rutpela maculata",
  "Stenurella melanura",
  "Corymbia rubra",
  # "Exoten" – je eine Art ihrer Familie, ökologisch sehr verschieden
  "Bolitophagus reticulatus",   # Pilzfresser
  "Ips typographus",            # Borkenkäfer
  "Pterostichus aethiops",      # Räuber
  "Uleiota planatus"            # Rindenkäfer, fungivor
)

beetles$species_clean <- factor(beetles$species_clean,
                                 levels = rev(species_order))

beetles[, c("species_clean", "family", "gilde", "nahrung", "wald",
            "niche_decay_num", "body_length", "hairiness_total")]
```

## Mykangia/ Flower Visitor

Nach Rücksprache mit Flavius: Mykangien/ Mycetome mit aufnehmen als spezialisierte Strukturen für Käfer-Pilz Assoziationen

```{r}
mycangia <- data.frame(
  species  = c("Anthaxia_fulgurans", "Anthaxia_quadripunctata",
               "Chrysobothris_affinis", "Buprestis_haemorrhoidalis",
               "Rhagium_bifasciatum", "Rhagium_inquisitor", "Rhagium_mordax",
               "Pachytodes_cerambyciformis", "Rutpela_maculata",
               "Stenurella_melanura", "Corymbia_rubra",
               "Bolitophagus_reticulatus",
               "Ips_typographus",
               "Pterostichus_aethiops",
               "Uleiota_planatus"),
  mycangia = c("no", "no", "no", "no",   # Buprestidae
               "yes", "yes", "yes",       # Rhagium: alle drei belegt
               "yes", "yes", "yes", "yes",       # Für Lepturinae in Buchner, Schomann, Kishigami, 2023 generell bestätigt
               "no",             # Tenebrionidae
               "yes",             # Ips
               "no",
               "no")             # Carabidae
)

flower_visitor <- data.frame(
  species = c("Anthaxia_fulgurans", "Anthaxia_quadripunctata",
              "Chrysobothris_affinis", "Buprestis_haemorrhoidalis",
              "Rhagium_bifasciatum", "Rhagium_inquisitor", "Rhagium_mordax",
              "Pachytodes_cerambyciformis", "Rutpela_maculata",
              "Stenurella_melanura", "Corymbia_rubra",
              "Bolitophagus_reticulatus",
              "Ips_typographus",
              "Pterostichus_aethiops",
              "Uleiota_planatus"),
  flower_visitor = c("yes", "yes", "no", "no",   # Buprestidae
                     "no", "no", "no",           # Rhagium (kein regelmäßiger Blütenbesuch lt. Klausnitzer)
                     "yes", "yes", "yes", "yes",         # Lepturinae
                     "no", "no", "no", "no")            # TE/CU/CA/SI
)

beetles <- beetles %>%
  left_join(mycangia,       by = "species") %>%
  left_join(flower_visitor, by = "species") %>%
  mutate(mycangia = as.factor(mycangia))
```

## Family als Spalte

```{r}
#| label: Family als Spalte

# Familie als extra Spalte einfügen
beetles_cat <- beetles %>%
  select(species_clean, family, gilde, nahrung, wald) %>%
  mutate(
    across(c(gilde, nahrung, wald), as.character),
    Family = family
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(-c(species_clean, family),
               names_to = "trait", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(trait = factor(trait,
    levels = c("Family", "gilde", "nahrung", "wald"),
    labels = c("Family", "Guild", "Feeding type", "Forest type"))) %>%
  print(n=100)


```





## Combined plot

```{r}
# ── Daten vorbereiten ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
beetles_plot <- beetles %>%
  filter(species_clean != "Grammoptera ruficornis") %>%
  mutate(
    mycangia      = as.factor(mycangia),
    species_clean = factor(species_clean,
                           levels = rev(gsub("_", " ", species_order)))
  )

beetles_plot %>% select(species, mycangia) %>% print()
# ── Alle Traits in ein langes Format bringen ──────────────────────────────────
beetles_cat_long <- beetles_plot %>%
  select(species_clean, family, gilde, wald, flower_visitor, mycangia) %>%
  mutate(
    across(c(gilde, wald), as.character),
    flower_visitor = as.character(flower_visitor),
    mycangia        = as.character(mycangia),
    Family          = as.character(family)
  ) %>%
  select(-family) %>%
  pivot_longer(-species_clean, names_to = "trait", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(trait = factor(trait,
    levels = c("Family", "gilde", "wald", "flower_visitor", "mycangia"),
    labels = c("Family", "Guild", "Forest type", "Flower visitor", "Mycangia/Mycetome")))

beetles_num_long <- beetles_plot %>%
  select(species_clean, body_length, hairiness_total) %>%
  pivot_longer(-species_clean, names_to = "trait", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(
    value = as.numeric(value),
    trait = factor(trait,
      levels = c("body_length", "hairiness_total"),
      labels = c("Length", "Hairiness"))
  ) %>%
  group_by(trait) %>%
  mutate(value_scaled = (value - min(value, na.rm = TRUE)) /
                        (max(value, na.rm = TRUE) - min(value, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
  ungroup()

# ── Gemeinsame Trait-Reihenfolge für das durchgehende Raster ──────────────────
all_trait_levels <- c("Family", "Guild", "Forest type", "Flower visitor",
                       "Length", "Hairiness", "Mycangia/Mycetome")

beetles_cat_long <- beetles_cat_long %>% mutate(trait = factor(trait, levels = all_trait_levels))
beetles_num_long <- beetles_num_long %>% mutate(trait = factor(trait, levels = all_trait_levels))

```

```{r}
beetles_num_long <- beetles_plot %>%
  select(species_clean, body_length, hairiness_total) %>%

all_trait_levels <- c("Family", "Guild", "Forest type", "Flower visitor",

beetles_cat_long <- beetles_cat_long %>% mutate(trait = factor(trait, levels = all_trait_levels))
beetles_num_long <- beetles_num_long %>% mutate(trait = factor(trait, levels = all_trait_levels))


```
```{r}
# ── Gruppen-Zuordnung für die Hintergrund-Markierung ──────────────────────────
trait_groups <- data.frame(
  trait = factor(c("Family", "Guild", "Forest type", "Flower visitor",
                    "Length", "Hairiness", "Mycangia/Mycetome"),
                 levels = all_trait_levels),
  group = c("Phylogeny", "Ecological", "Ecological", "Ecological",
            "Morphological", "Morphological", "Morphological")
)

group_colors <- c(
  "Phylogeny"     = "#E8E4F0",
  "Ecological"    = "#E0F0E8",
  "Morphological" = "#F0E8E0"
)

beetles_cat_long %>% print(n=100)

combined <- ggplot() +
  geom_tile(data = dplyr::filter(beetles_cat_long, trait == "Family"),
            aes(x = trait, y = species_clean, fill = value),
            color = "white", linewidth = 0.5, width = 0.95, height = 0.9) +
  geom_text(data = dplyr::filter(beetles_cat_long, trait == "Family"),
            aes(x = trait, y = species_clean, label = value),
            size = 7, color = "black", na.rm = TRUE) +
scale_fill_manual(values = c(
  "Buprestidae"   = "grey",
  "Cerambycidae"  = "grey",
  "Tenebrionidae" = "grey",
  "Curculionidae" = "grey",
  "Carabidae"     = "grey",
  "Silvanidae"    = "grey"
), na.value = "grey95") +
  ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
  # Layer 2: Ecological traits (Guild, Forest type, Flower visitor) -- Grün
  geom_tile(data = dplyr::filter(beetles_cat_long, trait %in% c("Guild", "Forest type", "Flower visitor")),
            aes(x = trait, y = species_clean, fill = value),
            color = "white", linewidth = 0.5, width = 0.95, height = 0.9) +
  geom_text(data = dplyr::filter(beetles_cat_long, trait %in% c("Guild", "Forest type", "Flower visitor")),
            aes(x = trait, y = species_clean, label = value),
            size = 7, na.rm = TRUE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "fresh wood" = "#E5F5E0", "old wood" = "#A1D99B", "wood-decay" = "#31A354",
    "deciduous"  = "#E5F5E0", "coniferous" = "#A1D99B", "both" = "#31A354",
    "yes"        = "#31A354", "no" = "#E5F5E0"
  ), na.value = "grey95") +
  ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
  # Layer 3: Mycangia (gehört zu Morpho, aber kategorial) -- Blau wie Layer 4
  geom_tile(data = dplyr::filter(beetles_cat_long, trait == "Mycangia/Mycetome"),
            aes(x = trait, y = species_clean, fill = value),
            color = "white", linewidth = 0.5, width = 0.95, height = 0.9) +
  geom_text(data = dplyr::filter(beetles_cat_long, trait == "Mycangia/Mycetome"),
            aes(x = trait, y = species_clean, label = value),
            size = 7, na.rm = TRUE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("yes" = "#2171B5", "no" = "#DEEBF7"), na.value = "grey95") +
  ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
  # Layer 4: numerische Morphologie-Traits (Length, Hairiness) -- Blau
  geom_tile(data = beetles_num_long,
            aes(x = trait, y = species_clean, fill = value_scaled),
            color = "white", linewidth = 0.5, width = 0.95, height = 0.9) +
  geom_text(data = beetles_num_long,
            aes(x = trait, y = species_clean, label = round(value, 1)),
            size = 7, na.rm = TRUE) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#DEEBF7", high = "#2171B5", na.value = "grey95") +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0.03, 0.03), drop = FALSE, position = "top") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 18) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y     = element_text(face = "italic", size = 20),
    axis.text.x     = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20, angle = 0),
    panel.grid      = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.spacing   = unit(0.3, "lines")
  )

combined

ggsave(file.path(base_path, "Results/Figures/beetle_traits_combined.pdf"),
       plot = combined, width = 18, height = 9)
```
